faults.title: Piston-ring trouble on early petrol engines
faults.description: Some early Astra K petrol engines have suffered piston-ring failure. Check the service record and investigate abnormal oil use, smoke or poor running before buying or continuing to drive a suspect car.

faults.title: Premature clutch wear
faults.description: Worn clutches have been reported even on low-mileage Astra K cars. Check for slipping, judder or an unusual biting point on a test drive and get the clutch inspected if any symptom is present.
